name: clean-untrusted-v1
description: clean_untrusted(text, limit=2000): text from outside (relay messages, webhooks) before it goes into ticket history or an agent prompt. In this order: NFC; U+2028/U+2029 become newline; drop control (Cc), format (Cf), unassigned (Cn) and surrogate (Cs) characters except newline and tab, every Default_Ignorable_Code_Point (U+00AD, U+034F, U+061C, U+115F-1160, U+17B4-17B5, U+180B-180F, U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2060-206F, U+3164, U+FE00-FE0F, U+FEFF, U+FFA0, U+FFF0-FFF8, U+1BCA0-1BCA3, U+1D173-1D17A, U+E0000-E0FFF) and U+2800; then remove <!-- ... --> comments, repeated until nothing changes; then remove an unterminated '<!--' and everything after it; cut to limit. Dropping invisible characters first means they cannot hide a comment marker. Cn follows the implementation's Unicode version; the vectors use code points unassigned for a long time (U+0378). Visible text is never rewritten. The relay's description rule (relay-api.md PATCH /v1/me) already rejects what this strips.
